data.title: The Hill Turbine
data.text:
The co-op turbine on the hill broke first. Six hundred and forty households had bought into the turbines; a share cost about a bicycle. The Riverside schoolteacher called it a start. Then the north cooling tower broke. After that, two tanks broke, while the tank farm across the river remained intact.

Ines Moreno’s inspection lists the bund as raised one metre. Beneath it, in her hand: “That is what adequate means. It is a word about the past.” I have put the co-op clipping beside the inspection. The pencil note sits beneath the bund entry.
